# Implementation Tasks - 2026-08-10

## Task 1: Verify and Enhance Claude Model Support in Provider Layer

**Category:** provider  
**Priority:** MODERATE  
**Effort:** ~2h  
**Complexity:** medium

### What

Audit and enhance the SAP AI Core provider layer to ensure it correctly handles all Claude 4.5/4.6/4.7 model variants, including proper parameter handling (temperature) and model ID routing.

### Why

Aider #5173 added support for new Claude model IDs including:
- `claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219`
- `claude-opus-4-1` / `claude-opus-4-1-20250805`
- `claude-opus-4-5` / `claude-opus-4-5-20251101`
- `claude-opus-4-6-20260205`
- `claude-opus-4-7-20260416`

Alexi uses SAP AI Core orchestration proxy with model IDs prefixed `sap-ai-core/anthropic--*`. The current ORCHESTRATION_MODELS list already includes some opus-4 variants (`anthropic--claude-4.7-opus`), but we need to verify:
1. All relevant model IDs are recognized
2. Temperature parameter is correctly handled for opus-4 models (deprecated in Claude 4)
3. Model routing works for all new variants
4. Documentation reflects current model support

Keeping the provider layer current ensures Alexi can use the latest Claude models as SAP AI Core deploys them.

### How

**Files to modify:**

1. **`src/providers/sapOrchestration.ts`** (line ~1513)
   - Review ORCHESTRATION_MODELS constant
   - Current list includes: `anthropic--claude-3.7-sonnet`, `anthropic--claude-4.5-haiku`, `anthropic--claude-4.5-sonnet`, `anthropic--claude-4.5-opus`, `anthropic--claude-4.7-opus`
   - Verify if dated variants need explicit entries (e.g., `anthropic--claude-opus-4-1`, `anthropic--claude-opus-4-6-20260205`)
   - Add missing variants if SAP AI Core supports them
   - Document model ID naming convention in comments

2. **`src/providers/model-match.ts`** (line ~88, ~106)
   - Review ANTHROPIC_MODELS constant (already includes `claude-opus-4`, `claude-opus-4-1221-v1`)
   - Verify coverage of new model IDs: `claude-opus-4-1`, `claude-opus-4-5`, `claude-opus-4-6`, `claude-opus-4-7`
   - Add missing IDs if needed
   - Ensure `isAnthropicModel()` correctly recognizes all variants with and without `sap-ai-core/anthropic--` prefix

3. **`src/providers/transform.ts`** (line ~434)
   - Review temperature parameter handling
   - Implement check for opus-4 family models to skip temperature parameter (deprecated)
   - Add logic: if model matches `opus-4` pattern, omit temperature from API payload
   - Add comment referencing Aider fix for context

4. **`routing-config.example.json`**
   - Review existing Claude model examples (line 22: `claude-3.5-sonnet`, line 40: `claude-4-sonnet`, line 49: `claude-opus-4`)
   - Consider adding example for dated variant (e.g., `claude-opus-4-7-20260416`)
   - Ensure documentation in comments reflects latest model support

5. **`src/providers/__tests__/model-match.test.ts`**
   - Add test cases for new model IDs:
     - `claude-opus-4-1` routes correctly
     - `claude-opus-4-5` routes correctly
     - `claude-opus-4-6` routes correctly
     - `claude-opus-4-7` routes correctly
     - Dated variants (e.g., `claude-opus-4-7-20260416`) route correctly
     - `sap-ai-core/anthropic--claude-opus-4-X` prefixed variants route correctly
   - Test temperature parameter is omitted for opus-4 models

6. **`src/providers/__tests__/transform.test.ts`** (or new test file)
   - Add test: temperature parameter is NOT sent for opus-4 models
   - Add test: temperature parameter IS sent for older Claude models (3.x, 4.5-sonnet)
   - Verify parameter transformation respects model family

7. **`.env.example`**
   - Update AICORE_MODEL example to reference a current model ID
   - Consider adding comment listing supported Claude model families

### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] All Claude 4.5/4.6/4.7 model IDs from Aider #5173 are recognized by Alexi's model matching logic
- [ ] ORCHESTRATION_MODELS and ANTHROPIC_MODELS constants are up-to-date with latest Claude releases
- [ ] Temperature parameter is correctly omitted for opus-4 family models
- [ ] Model routing tests pass for all new model IDs (bare, prefixed, dated variants)
- [ ] Temperature handling tests pass (omitted for opus-4, present for others)
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes with 0 errors
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes with new test coverage
- [ ] `npm run format:check` passes
- [ ] Documentation in comments reflects current model support and parameter handling

### Testing

```bash
# Run provider tests
npm test -- src/providers/__tests__/model-match.test.ts
npm test -- src/providers/__tests__/transform.test.ts

# Run full test suite
npm test

# Verify type safety
npm run typecheck

# Check formatting
npm run format:check

# Lint
npm run lint
```

### Dependencies

None - standalone provider layer enhancement.

### Notes

- SAP AI Core model availability may lag behind Anthropic releases; ORCHESTRATION_MODELS should reflect what SAP actually supports
- Model IDs use double-dash convention: `anthropic--claude-X-Y`
- Temperature deprecation in opus-4 is per Aider #5173 fix
- Existing tests in `model-match.test.ts` already reference `claude-opus-4`, so foundation is in place
- `model-match.ts` comment (line ~92) mentions "Added claude-opus-4, sonnet-4.5, sonnet-4.7 + -1221-v1 variants" suggesting recent work on this area
